To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
g MnO2 is the most active phase in the gas phase CO oxidation and selective oxidation of ethanol.
g MnO2 is the most efficient catalyst among four MnO2 crystal structures, and that the surface reducibility and acidity basicity play a crucial role in the CO and ethanol oxidation, respectively.
the gas phase CO oxidation and selective ethanol oxidation over metal dopped MnO2 can be tuned by the surface reducibility and acidity basicity.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the elucidation of the structure performance correlations in the gas phase oxidation reactions over metal doped MnO2, which provides a better understanding on the structural requirements of MnOx based catalysts for the gas phase selective oxidation reactions.
the structure performance correlations of MnO2 based catalysts and provides a better understanding of the catalytic mechanism of MnO2 in gas phase selective oxidation of ethanol.
the structural and component effects in g MnO2 based catalysts for the gas phase CO oxidation and ethanol oxidation and the different structural requirements of MnOx for the two reactions.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the reducibility is the most important factor to determine the catalytic activity for both CO and ethanol oxidation, but the surface acidity basicities are more crucial for the selective oxidation of ethanol.
the g MnO2 is the most efficient catalyst among four types of Mn2O3 for the complete oxidation of CO and selective oxidation of ethanol.
the MnO2 structure is more crucial for the CO oxidation, while the reducibility of MnO2 is the key for the selective ethanol oxidation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the reducibility of the catalyst is more relevant for the ethanol oxidation, whereas surface acidity basicity is more relevant for CO oxidation.
the g MnO2 based catalysts are more suitable for the complete oxidation of CO, while the a and b MnO2 based materials are more efficient for selective oxidation of ethanol.
the reducibility of g MnOx is crucial to the catalytic activity in both CO oxidation and selective ethanol oxidation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the gas phase CO oxidation and ethanol oxidation can be catalyzed by the same g MnO2 phase with the same metal dopants.
the gas phase CO and ethanol oxidation over MnO2 catalyst can be optimized by tuning the reducibility and surface acidity basicity of MnO2.

the catalytic performance of the MnO2 in gas phase selective oxidation of ethanol or CO oxidation is not only related to the reducibility and oxygen vacancy, but also to the surface acidity/basicity of MnO2.
